From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@echelonhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan kickoff — ops checklist, attendee roll call & Zoom

Jane —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to get a 45–60 minute mutual action plan (MAP) kickoff on the calendar to align stakeholders, confirm the evaluation plan, and lock a close timeline. Proposed goals for the call:

- Introductions and stakeholder roles (who owns metrics, security, product sign-off)
- Walk the MAP draft (milestones, checkpoints, owners) — see attached MAP_Draft_v1.pdf
- Agree on evaluation plan (test set, success criteria, timelines)
- Logistics: calendar hold, Zoom host/co-hosts, and artifacts (Drive links, test data)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed, Jun 2, 10:00–11:00
- Thu, Jun 3, 09:00–10:00

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (final invite to follow)

Please confirm which slot works and who from Echelon should be in the room (security, product, ML lead). If there are other stakeholders we should include for procurement or legal, flag them and we’ll loop them in.

Quick ops notes: we plan to share a lightweight evaluation_testset_v1.csv during the call and a follow-up checklist to capture action owners. I’ll send a calendar hold once you confirm a time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Karthik —

Thanks — Thu, Jun 3 at 09:00 PT works best for our team. I’ve added Carlos Rivera (ML Ops lead) to the thread; he’ll join along with our security contact (I’m confirming a name and will send in a follow-up).

A couple quick asks before the call:
- Can you include a one-line scope for SOC2 / data handling to help my security team triage?
- If you’ll be sharing the test set during the call, please confirm it’s a synthetic or redacted file — we won’t send any production PHI into shared Drive links.

We’ll plan for 09:00–10:00 PT on Jun 3. Please send the calendar invite with the final Zoom and co-host settings.

Appreciate it,

Jane Doe
Director of Product Operations | Echelon Health

Great — calendar hold is in and final Zoom below. I’ll also attach the redacted evaluation test set and the .ics to this thread.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1112223333 (passcode: Redwood123)
Host: Karthik Iyer
Co-hosts: Lauren Bishop, Ben Carter

Attendee roll call (Redwood):
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions lead / MAP facilitation (owns MAP readout and follow-ups)

Ops checklist for the call (will read out first 5 mins):

2) Walk MAP_Draft_v1.pdf milestones and owners (we’ll annotate live)
3) Review evaluation_testset_v1.csv (redacted) and success criteria
4) Agree on close timeline and first checkpoint (target: contract decision by 2027-07-15)
5) Action owners and next steps (we’ll capture in the HubSpot deal)

Attachments: evaluation_testset_v1.csv (redacted example), redwood_map_kickoff.ics
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-ECH-48

Thanks — see you Thursday.
